findings.claim: Concrete market-creation callbacks are incorrectly marked eventless.
findings.resolution: Producer repair is in progress; final-byte readback is pending.
findings.location: IHooks.onCreateMarket dispatches to OpenTermHooks, FixedTermHooks and PeriodicTermHooks; source details and all 5 action IDs are in the machine record.
findings.mechanism: The helper traversal stops at the abstract declaration before resolving the runtime override.
findings.impact: MinimumDepositUpdated, FixedTermUpdated and PeriodicTermUpdated disappear from the action rows.
findings.fix: Resolve the virtual override, retain its conditions and emitter context, and reconcile factory joins.

findings.claim: The readiness reports give the ArchController owner separate SphereX powers.
findings.resolution: Producer repair is in progress; final-byte readback is pending.
findings.location: candidate src/WildcatArchController.sol:99; src/spherex/SphereXConfig.sol:142 and src/spherex/SphereXConfig.sol:150; the deployed pin has the same role split.
findings.mechanism: Ownable owner, SphereX admin and SphereX operator use independent storage; ownership transfer does not move the SphereX roles.
findings.impact: The actor table attributes engine changes to the wrong authority.
findings.fix: Name registry ownership and SphereX admin/operator authority separately, including diagram actor labels.

findings.claim: The deployed default coverage failure is misreported.
findings.resolution: Producer repair is in progress; final-byte readback is pending.
findings.mechanism: Default coverage fails Solar analysis on unresolved symbol locals; only the IR fallback reports Yul stack depth.
findings.impact: The report obscures the recorded failure and the execution record could inherit that error.
findings.fix: Record default Solar failure and the 3-slot IR failure separately; candidate default is solc stack depth and candidate IR is 6-slot Yul depth.

findings.claim: Queue-hook effects omit term restrictions and describe a reverted credential clear as persistent.
findings.resolution: Producer repair is in progress; final-byte readback is pending.
findings.location: deployed src/access/FixedTermHooks.sol:306; candidate src/access/FixedTermHooks.sol:371 and src/access/PeriodicTermHooks.sol:580; all 5 queue callbacks need the persistence correction.
findings.mechanism: Fixed-term queueing requires maturity; periodic queueing requires an open window unless closed. Failed credential validation reverts the outer callback.
findings.impact: The map understates successful-call conditions and overstates durable credential changes.
findings.fix: Apply the role-specific replacement text in the machine record and retain only successful refresh/grant effects.

findings.claim: I-1 uses an intermediate storage-write boundary.
findings.resolution: Producer repair is in progress; final-byte readback is pending.
findings.location: candidate src/market/WildcatMarket.sol:66 and src/market/WildcatMarket.sol:73; deployed src/market/WildcatMarket.sol:78 and src/market/WildcatMarket.sol:85.
findings.mechanism: Account storage is written before aggregate state is persisted.
findings.impact: The identity does not hold after every individual write.
findings.fix: State the identity at completion of each successful external call, after paired account and aggregate writes.

findings.claim: Several flow labels and the APR execution flag need precision.
findings.resolution: Producer repair is in progress; final-byte readback is pending.
findings.location: both entry-points.md flow sections; candidate src/types/HooksConfig.sol:291 and src/market/WildcatMarketConfig.sol:202.
findings.mechanism: The provider calls hook.grantRole; the user calls the market before the periodic hook; dedicated APR execution has its own flag. Repayment methods are alternative funding paths.
findings.impact: The abbreviated paths can imply the wrong call target, required predecessor or enabled callback.
findings.fix: Name both sides of callback calls, use Bit_Enabled_ExecutePendingAnnualInterestBipsReduction, and branch repay versus repayAndProcessUnpaidWithdrawalBatches.
